english.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for the inside of a building, container, or other enclosed place.
Use 入面 as the all-purpose spoken term for the physical interior of a place or object.

examples.english: The interior of the cinema is quite nice, with lots of comfortable seats.
examples.traditional: 間戲院嘅入面幾靚，仲有好多舒服嘅座位。
